what_it_does.name: prisma-cli
what_it_does.summary: Command reference for the Prisma ORM 7 CLI, made of an overview in SKILL.md and 20 reference files, one per command or topic. It covers prisma init, generate, validate, format, dev, db pull, push, seed and execute, the migrate commands, studio, mcp, complete and debug, with their options, examples and workflows. Destructive commands go through an AI safety checkpoint that needs the user's explicit consent. Use it in existing Prisma 7 applications or explicitly selected Prisma 7 workflows, not for setup, connection repair or Prisma 8.
tasks: initialize a Prisma 7 project with prisma init
generate Prisma Client with prisma generate
create, apply, check, diff and resolve migrations
introspect, push, seed and run raw SQL against a database
run a local Prisma Postgres database with prisma dev
validate and format the Prisma schema
open Prisma Studio, start the MCP server, print debug info and shell completions
what_it_does.author_description: Prisma ORM 7 CLI reference for existing Prisma 7 applications or explicitly selected Prisma 7 workflows. Covers prisma init, generate, migrate, db, dev, studio, and mcp. For setup, connection repair, or Prisma 8, use prisma-orm-setup; not the Prisma Platform CLI.

risks.risk: Instructions placed in a remote database schema or a SQL file can reach the agent when it introspects a database with prisma db pull or reads schemas with prisma migrate diff.
risks.mitigation: consent checkpoint for destructive commands in place, no sanitisation of ingested content stated

risks.risk: All data in the database is lost when prisma migrate reset, prisma db push --force-reset or prisma db push --accept-data-loss runs against it.
risks.mitigation: Prisma blocks these commands for a detected AI agent until the user gives explicit consent, in place

risks.risk: Running prisma migrate dev against a production database can end in a reset prompt on drift, and a reset deletes all data.
risks.mitigation: use prisma migrate deploy in production, not enforced

risks.risk: Manual customizations of the schema file are lost when prisma db pull overwrites it.
risks.mitigation: commit the schema first and preview with --print, not enforced

risks.risk: Anyone who reaches Prisma Studio gets direct database access when it runs on a public network.
risks.mitigation: run only on local machines or secure internal networks, not enforced

risks.risk: A database password passed in a --url connection string on the command line stays in shell history or logs.
Schema and database context leave the machine when prisma mcp is connected to a hosted AI tool such as ChatGPT or Claude.

limitations: The commands and examples apply to Prisma ORM 7 only.
prisma db execute reports success or failure, not query results, is primarily for SQL databases and is not supported on MongoDB.
MongoDB does not support migrations, so db push is the only schema workflow there.
MongoDB introspection samples documents and may need manual refinement.
prisma migrate dev requires a shadow database, handled automatically only for local Prisma Postgres.
prisma migrate status exits 0 with pending migrations, so detecting them needs parsing the output or migrate diff --exit-code.
Prisma Studio is a development tool limited to the configured database and in Prisma 7 targets PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite first.
Under Bun, Prisma falls back to Node.js without the --bun flag because of the CLI shebang.
npx and bunx do not provide shell completion.

known_problems.problem: a migration fails in prisma migrate deploy
known_problems.workaround: fix the issue, mark it with prisma migrate resolve --applied and rerun prisma migrate deploy

known_problems.problem: db push or migrate dev warns of data loss
known_problems.workaround: decide whether data loss is acceptable, then use --accept-data-loss with the user's explicit consent
reset the database with prisma migrate reset after consent, or check with migrate status

known_problems.problem: a seed script fails on its second run
known_problems.workaround: use upsert to make seeds re-runnable
